description: N++ is the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, or 6th game in the N franchise depending on who you ask. Created by Metanet Software, the N franchise started as a flash game, saw multiple console releases in N+, and the franchise recieved it's ultimate game in N++. The goal of each level is simple, reach the door switch then reach the door before time expires, collecting gold along the way to extend your time.
